results.overview: Every teenager thinks their parents are evil. What if you found out they actually were? Six diverse teenagers who can barely stand each other must unite against a common foe – their parents.
results.name: Marvel's Runaways

results.overview: A psychologist tracked down runaways in what began as a short-run series called `Operation: Runaway,' which aired in the spring of 1978. It was slated for a fall pickup, but was shelved until the following spring, when it had a new title and some new cast members, including Alan Feinstein, who replaced Robert Reed (four years removed from `The Brady Bunch').
results.name: The Runaways

results.overview: While two teenagers disappear from an elite private school, a brutal murder takes place in nearby suburbia. Five different students must now work together to make sense of it all, in order to escape their own haunted pasts.
results.name: Runaways

results.overview: Today is a special day for Su-Ji (Seo Yea-Ji). She decides that she is not going to school today, but first she has to ditch her father's employee who is following her. Kim Yeo-Jin (Jang Hee-Jin) doesn't want to work at the hostess bar today even though her boss (Lee Han-Wi) is threatening her. She decides to make a run for it while in the bathroom. Hyung-Ja (Park Hae-Mi) is treated like property by her husband and son. She decides to make a run for it, when she tells her husband and son that she will go buy some food for dinner. Su-Ji, Kim Yeo-Jin and Hyung-Ja all converge at the park, while they are all being chased by men who want to take them back. They decide to escape together.
results.name: The Three Female Runaways
